coverage_decision: All substantive chapter text was mapped; all 19 numbered recommendation statements are represented, with compound graded clauses split into independently reviewable recommendation atoms where appropriate. All 3 local tables, 2 local figures, and the Figure 11.2 workflow are reconciled. The complete 159-item bibliography is preserved separately as a reference task queue and is not atomized.
omissions_and_reasons: Pure bibliography entries were not atomized; they are provenance/follow-up infrastructure and are retained in the reference task queue.
Cross-referenced material from other Standards sections was not reconstructed because it is outside dc26s011.pdf.
Cited primary publications were not independently retrieved; trial findings in ATOM/SEA are explicitly represented as the chapter’s secondary reports.
large_source_decision: Semantic batching used because the chapter spans multiple recommendation families, dense pharmacotherapy evidence, three tables, two figures, an algorithmic workflow, and 159 references.
